Find the number of bricks, each measuring 18 cm × 12 cm × 10 cm, required to construct a wall 48 m long, 23 m high and 0.5 m thick, while the sand and cement mixture occupies 10% of the total volume of wall.

A and B start a business. A invests ₹5,000 more than B and keeps his capital invested for 4 months, while B invests his capital for 5 months. The total profit at the end of the business is ₹55,000, and A’s share of the profit is ₹5,000 more than B’s share. Find the amount of capital contributed by A.

A dealer allows a 25% discount on an article and still manages to make a 53% profit. Find the ratio of the cost price to the listed price.
